section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section provides the header information for the maamar, including the Torah portion, date, and year.
This section notes that the maamar is an unedited discourse.
This section introduces the phrase "You are One" and questions the unique superiority of the Minchah prayer on Shabbat over all other prayers.
section.t: and Your Name is One, and who is like Your people Israel, one nation in the land, etc.
Now, this text is recited during the Minchah prayer of Shabbat,
the ratzon of ratzonot (the will of wills).
And it is necessary to understand what is the virtue of the Minchah prayer of Shabbat over all prayers,
that specifically then we say "You are One," etc., which speaks about the Holy One, Blessed be He, Himself.
And particularly according to what is explained in the discourse on this topic by the Baal HaHilula (the master of the celebration),
that in this text are explained all the levels in Atzilus and above Atzilus,
all aspects of Hishtalshelus (the chain of descent) and that which is above Hishtalshelus.
